reasoning: 驗證目標：HU 顯示 Preset List 時，選取其中一個項目，HU 調諧至該 preset。關鍵情境條件：清單中至少兩個 preset 各存不同電台，使對應關係可觀察（§7）。為什麼這樣切：一條 TC 內以兩個 preset 驗證同一觸發的對應關係，依 §5.7 不拆分。與兄弟 leaf 的關係（依 §8.2.2 不做 TC 側合併）：本 leaf 的驗證對象是 Enter / Item Select 這個清單導覽互動作用在 Preset List 上的結果，022 的對象是 browse presets 畫面上的 short press 觸控事件，034 的對象是 preset 按鍵召回記憶體內容的對應關係——三者觸發路徑不同，維持各自的 leaf。上游三處條文高度相近，屬 Q-AM2 同類的近子集重疊，送 RD-1 認知。刻意略過：preset 的儲存與 PI code 判準由 Presets 批次覆蓋。

tcs.tc_title: Selecting an item on the Preset List tunes to that preset
tcs.test_item: While the HU is displaying a Preset List, and an item is selected, the HU shall tune to the selected preset
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. Preset 1 and preset 3 are set to receivable stations on different frequencies
5. A Preset List is displayed and the HU is tuned to a frequency held in no preset
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the tuned frequency and the items on the Preset List
2. Select the preset 1 item on the list
3. Read the tuned frequency
4. Select the preset 3 item on the list
5. Read the tuned frequency
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency is displayed and the preset items are displayed with their assignments
2. The selection of the preset 1 item is accepted
3. The HU is tuned to the frequency held in preset 1 and that station is played
4. The selection of the preset 3 item is accepted
5. The HU is tuned to the frequency held in preset 3 and that station is played
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
